column7: SetSecretTags, SetSecretDescription and MoveSecret accepted the owner pass alone, so a viewer who owned a secret could change its tags, description or location through a direct core call while REST refused them (known-03 / #4160 pattern). enforceSecretWriteGate re-checks an owner-sourced grant against secrets.write and the route's SecretAction. Defence in depth: REST already refused. Found by the SUPERFAN-1118 review of #4336
